visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An elderly man wearing a pink t-shirt bends over a collection of silver flying fish on a rocky shore, meticulously removing their internal organs. Behind him, several motorcycles are parked near a simple wooden and metal structure under the bright, natural light of a clear day. (2) A middle-aged man sits on the ground, using a metal knife to scrape scales off a flying fish. He is joined by a young man in a black tank top and a woman in a black hat and glasses who observe his work with curious expressions. The background shows a vast coastline with green hills and traditional canoes. (3) Close-up shots show the cleaning process, with water being poured from a blue tub over the fish. The middle-aged man holds up a fish, fanning out its vibrant blue, wing-like pectoral fins for the camera. The young male host attempts to assist, looking hesitant as he handles the slippery fish. (4) The group gathers around as the middle-aged man presents a white, creamy substance extracted from the fish. The hosts react with high-arousal facial expressions, laughing and pointing. A static food shot briefly appears, showing the white milt garnished with green onions and citrus on a ceramic plate. (5) The male host takes a piece of the milt and eats it, his eyes widening in surprise. He then turns to the woman, and they both laugh as they approach a man holding a professional camera. (6) The camera operator opens his mouth wide as the hosts playfully feed him a large piece of the fish milt. Everyone is laughing as the scene ends on the rocky beach near the ocean waves.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 哈哈台. [Slogan]: 在分工明確的雅美 (達悟) 族社會中. (2) [Subtitle]: 每年春夏各部落從招魚祭開始. (3) [Subtitle]: 長達半年的飛魚季中. (4) [Subtitle]: 男人們負責出海抓魚. (5) [Subtitle]: 且有許多傳統需要遵守. (6) [Logo]: 麥可哥. [Subtitle]: 通常你們這個飛魚是只能在岸邊處理喔. (7) [Subtitle]: 對，只能在這邊刮魚鱗. (8) [Subtitle]: 為什麼不能帶上去刮魚? (9) [Subtitle]: 以前的傳統都這樣，因為以前可能不方便啦. (10) [Subtitle]: 沒有水嘛. (11) [Subtitle]: 在家裡處理會臭掉. (12) [Subtitle]: 因為我不知道刮魚鱗要怎樣刮. (13) [Subtitle]: 你沒有刮過魚鱗是不是? (14) [Subtitle]: 好像沒有. (15) [Variety]: 真正的男人用看的就要會. (16) [Subtitle]: 魚鱗是一面還是兩面? (17) [Variety]: (偷笑). (18) [Subtitle]: 兩面都會有對不對? (19) [Subtitle]: 肚子會有魚鱗嗎? (20) [Variety]: 鱗老師要生氣了. (21) [Subtitle]: 太漂亮了吧. (22) [Variety]: 帶頭的飛魚. (23) [Subtitle]: 一百隻五十隻裡面可能只有一隻. (24) [Subtitle]: 所以他可以賣比較貴嗎? (25) [Subtitle]: 沒有. [Variety]: 飛魚王. (26) [Subtitle]: 這送你吃啦，你們分著吃啦. (27) [Subtitle]: 這是什麼? (28) [Subtitle]: 精囊嗎? [Variety]: 洨. (29) [Subtitle]: 謝謝我都已經用精囊盡量委婉了. (30) [Variety]: 洨知識. (31) [Subtitle]: 魚類的精囊就是日式料理常見的白子喔. (32) [Subtitle]: 蠻好吃的耶. (33) [Subtitle]: 就說你們來蘭嶼有吃過洨這樣. (34) [Subtitle]: 來吃看看. (35) [Subtitle]: 整塊吃下去那個味道就是小卷的蛋. (36) [Variety]: 最大包的洨. (37) [Variety]: 吃洨囉. (38) [Subtitle]: 有點太多了.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A rocky pebble beach with white waves crashing on the shore. Traditional Lanyu canoes (tatala) are visible in the distance alongside some simple residential or utility sheds and parked scooters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar music with a gentle percussive beat plays continuously. A male narrator introduces the Lanyu flying fish season with a clear, authoritative yet warm tone. Soft sounds of splashing water and metallic knife scraping against fish scales are audible in the background. (2) The scene shifts to a dialogue between a male host, a female host, and a local resident named Mike. Their voices are animated and casual. A sharp 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a joke about the host's lack of fish-cleaning experience. Laughter is frequently heard among the group. (3) The rhythmic sound of water and fish handling continues. The BGM remains steady. The male host's voice exhibits higher pitch and arousal as he reacts to the 'flying fish king'. A series of short comedy-themed audio stingers punctuate the fast-paced conversation. (4) The discussion turns to the fish milt. The vocal energy spikes with loud, high-pitched laughter and expressive vocalizations like 'whoa' and 'ew'. A subtle bubble-pop sound effect accompanies the appearance of variety-show text. The music stays bright and melodic underneath the speech. (5) As the hosts taste the milt, their chewing sounds and verbal affirmations of flavor are recorded with high clarity. The background noise of the outdoor coast is minimal. More high-arousal group laughter follows as they joke about the cameraman eating. (6) The video concludes with a burst of group laughter and energetic shouting as the cameraman is fed. The acoustic BGM swells in volume slightly before cutting off cleanly at the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Cultural Introduction -> Process Demonstration -> Taste Challenge -> Comedic Climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce the traditional flying fish processing culture of the Tao people in Lanyu while providing entertainment through a humorous host interaction and food tasting challenge.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends ethnographic education with social media comedy, utilizing high-quality location audio and expressive visual editing.
